title: Meade County Fiscal Court seeks part-time administrative assistant for Planning and Zoning office
text:

Government
Meade County Fiscal Court seeks part-time administrative assistant for Planning and Zoning office
Meade County Fiscal Court is hiring a part-time administrative assistant for its Planning & Zoning office. Applications are due by October 29, with in-house candidates given priority and standard employment checks required.
Meade County Fiscal Court announced on Oct. 15 that it is accepting resumes and applications for a part-time administrative assistant position within the Meade County Planning & Zoning office.
Interested applicants can request an application by emailing [email protected] or by visiting the Meade County Finance Office at 516 Hillcrest Drive, Brandenburg, Kentucky. Additional information is available by calling the finance office at 270-422-3967.
Completed applications must be returned no later than 4:00 PM on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The announcement states that in-house applicants will receive first consideration for the position. All applicants will be subject to drug testing and a background check.
The Meade County Fiscal Court describes itself as an Equal Opportunity Employer. Application forms can also be downloaded from the county’s official website.
